CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle automatic application of the glyph overlay
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_overlay

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Blend amount for overlaying glyph/media onto the scene
CONTROLS.NAME: overlay_glyphs

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Base seed color used by the scene palette. TIP: Checkout the grayer areas of each color
CONTROLS.NAME: color_seed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of media texture blended onto scene surfaces
CONTROLS.NAME: show_media

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Global time-rate multiplier (currently unused in shader)
CONTROLS.NAME: time_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle automatic post-process flip driven by bass presence
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_flip

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manual blend amount for the post-process mirror/flip effect
CONTROLS.NAME: flip

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Camera FOV / bubble distortion amount used in view-ray mixing
CONTROLS.NAME: bubble_cam

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle automatic FOV/bubble driven by bass presence
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_bubble

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Use square (box-like) bubble distortion instead of circular
CONTROLS.NAME: square_bubble

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Perspective morph amount (mixes view towards spherical/warped projection)
CONTROLS.NAME: perspective

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Toggle automatic morphing driven by audio presence
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_morph
